style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=16;align=left;fontFamily=Arial;"><mxGeometry as="geometry" x="35" y="65" width="2425.968" height="65" /></mxCell><mxCell id="notes" value="UML entity model: solid lines are associations; multiplicities describe the named roles, not database integrity. Attributes use [0..1] for optional values and [0..*] for lists. {PK}/{UQ} are schema-key constraints. Enforced relations and scalar-ID mappings are listed below; cross-service IDs are not foreign keys.<br>UNIQUE(seriesId,episodeNumber) orders episodes. ViewSession PK is (userId,reelId,playbackSessionId). ViewEvent UNIQUE(userId,reelId,playbackSessionId,sequence). Outbox aggregate and playback-session correlation links have no declared FK.<br>series: seriesId; nullable; onDelete SetNull (declared SQL FK); reel: reelId; Cascade delete (declared SQL FK); reel: reelId; Cascade delete (declared SQL FK); reel: reelId; Cascade delete (declared SQL FK); reel: reelId; Cascade delete (declared SQL FK); aggregate: aggregateId when aggregateType=REEL (logical) (scalar-ID<br>association; no declared FK); playback session: userId + reelId + playbackSessionId correlation (scalar-ID association; no declared FK)" vertex="1" parent="1" style="shape=note;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;fillColor=#fff8ed;strokeColor=#687782;"><mxGeometry as="geometry" x="35" y="1574.992" width="2425.968" height="108" /></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>

xhtml:div.xhtml:div:
UML entity model: solid lines are associations; multiplicities describe the named roles, not database integrity. Attributes use [0..1] for optional values and [0..*] for lists. {PK}/{UQ} are schema-key constraints. Enforced relations and scalar-ID mappings are listed below; cross-service IDs are not foreign keys.
UNIQUE(seriesId,episodeNumber) orders episodes. ViewSession PK is (userId,reelId,playbackSessionId). ViewEvent UNIQUE(userId,reelId,playbackSessionId,sequence). Outbox aggregate and playback-session correlation links have no declared FK.
series: seriesId; nullable; onDelete SetNull (declared SQL FK); reel: reelId; Cascade delete (declared SQL FK); reel: reelId; Cascade delete (declared SQL FK); reel: reelId; Cascade delete (declared SQL FK); reel: reelId; Cascade delete (declared SQL FK); aggregate: aggregateId when aggregateType=REEL (logical) (scalar-ID
association; no declared FK); playback session: userId + reelId + playbackSessionId correlation (scalar-ID association; no declared FK)
